FIELD.NAME: provider
FIELD.COMMENT: Provider class name from classes/local/provider/, falls back to generic

FIELD.NAME: metadataurl
FIELD.COMMENT: IDP metadata URL, refreshed after logins

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: IDP name visible on the login page

FIELD.NAME: enabled
FIELD.COMMENT: Disabled idp is hidden and cannot be used

FIELD.NAME: entityid
FIELD.COMMENT: Entity ID of the IDP, SAML allows 1024 chars but 255 is the indexable limit and enough in practice

FIELD.NAME: ssourl
FIELD.COMMENT: Single Sign-On URL

FIELD.NAME: logouturl
FIELD.COMMENT: Single logout URL, empty when the IDP has none

FIELD.NAME: certjson
FIELD.COMMENT: Cached metadata: certificates, NameID format, advertised attributes and refresh state

FIELD.NAME: customsettingsjson
FIELD.COMMENT: Overrides of php-saml library settings in JSON format

FIELD.NAME: attrsimple
FIELD.COMMENT: If enabled short attribute names may be used instead of full URIs

FIELD.NAME: mapattr
FIELD.COMMENT: Attribute holding the permanent IDP account id, nameid means the SAML NameID

FIELD.NAME: autologin
FIELD.COMMENT: If enabled and there is only one idp available user is logged in automatically

FIELD.NAME: autocreate
FIELD.COMMENT: If enabled unknown IDP accounts get a new user, needs username and email mappings

FIELD.NAME: automap
FIELD.COMMENT: If enabled unmapped musaml users are mapped at first login using attributes flagged usermapping

FIELD.NAME: usernameprefix
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional lowercase username prefix, applied when creating and when matching users

FIELD.NAME: tenantid
FIELD.COMMENT: Tenant login page the IDP belongs to, NULL means all login pages

INDEX.NAME: entityid
INDEX.COMMENT: The same IDP cannot be added twice

INDEX.NAME: tenantid
INDEX.COMMENT: Used instead of foreign key because multi-tenancy tables may not be available

TABLE.NAME: auth_musaml_user
TABLE.COMMENT: Mapping of users to IDP accounts, created in advance or at first login

FIELD.NAME: guid
FIELD.COMMENT: Permanent account id in the IDP

FIELD.NAME: allowotherauth
FIELD.COMMENT: Allow login through the IDP for users kept on another auth method

FIELD.NAME: automapped
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 when the mapping was created automatically at first login

KEY.NAME: userid
KEY.COMMENT: User can be mapped to one IDP only

TABLE.NAME: auth_musaml_attribute
TABLE.COMMENT: Mapping of IDP attributes to user fields

FIELD.NAME: idpattr
FIELD.COMMENT: Short or full IDP attribute name

FIELD.NAME: userfield
FIELD.COMMENT: User field name, may use profile_ prefix

FIELD.NAME: sync
FIELD.COMMENT: 0 never, 1 when the user is created, 2 after each login

FIELD.NAME: usermapping
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 means the attribute is used for automatic mapping, all flagged attributes must match

TABLE.NAME: auth_musaml_login
TABLE.COMMENT: Logins in progress, the identity provider response arrives without a Moodle session

FIELD.NAME: token
FIELD.COMMENT: Random value kept in a cookie of the browser that started the login

FIELD.NAME: requestid
FIELD.COMMENT: ID of the sent authentication request, the response must answer it

FIELD.NAME: wantsurl
FIELD.COMMENT: Where to go after the login

FIELD.NAME: test
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 for an admin test login, nobody is logged in

FIELD.NAME: ready
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 after the response was accepted, a second response is refused

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: User the response resolved to, NULL when there is none yet

FIELD.NAME: resultjson
FIELD.COMMENT: Attributes of an accepted response, or the reason it failed

FIELD.NAME: timeexpires
FIELD.COMMENT: Rows are deleted after this time

TABLE.NAME: auth_musaml_assertion
TABLE.COMMENT: Received assertion ids kept until they expire to detect replayed responses

FIELD.NAME: assertionid
FIELD.COMMENT: ID attribute of the assertion

FIELD.NAME: timeexpires
FIELD.COMMENT: NotOnOrAfter plus clock skew, rows are deleted after this time
